concept: Aurora Global Database: cross-Region reads and DR
tests: Knowing the Aurora feature for cross-Region replication with RPO ~1 s and RTO ~1 min.
expected: Aurora Global Database — storage replication to secondary Regions, RPO ~1 s, RTO ~1 min on promote. Triggers: "Aurora", "cross-Region", "RPO about 1 second", "recovery about a minute".
why_not: Aurora Multi-AZ in one Region and RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster provide only in-Region HA; Aurora Serverless v2 is about scaling, not DR.
